text: The author identifies the newer saveToFile route as the step intended to reach DownloadIntegration.downloadDone; the rest largely exposes/moves the helper. The reviewer accepts an explicit fire-and-forget explanation because the native flavor callback must return while saving continues. A duplicate-reading question is explicitly nonblocking, and the author only thinks it might happen. Existing source lessons cover current save/list semantics and the caller’s URI-versus-Boolean mismatch; this review does not establish the native download completion chain or an observed Windows Mark-of-the-Web result. The child removal review leaves JavaScript file-picker callback documentation out of scope. Partial historical evidence: Bug 1805986comment5 unavailable; no new runtime validation.
title: Preserve the drag callback boundary while routing attachment saves through Downloads
